messages.author: 83b47a60324ef98b
messages.subject: Default library in linux server
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to deploy my code over the web through shiny server using my linux machine. I was wondering which library R uses when running as server because I installed the necessary packages to run my code and it gives me an error saying they are not found, especially for the package 'forecast'. I got this error package/namespace load failed for ‘forecast’ . i also installed all the dependencies just in case and did not work. Any insights? Thanks

.libPaths()
[1] "~/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/2.15"
[2] "/usr/local/lib/R/site-library"                              
[3] "/usr/lib/R/site-library"                                    
[4] "/usr/lib/R/library"

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Default library in linux server
parts:
You either need to "sudo su --login" (to install as root, into /usr/local/lib/R/site-library) or "sudo su --login shiny" (to install into the "shiny" user's personal library, assuming you even gave the shiny user a home directory).

Here's the one-liner to install forecast as root into the site-library:

sudo su --login -c "R -e \"install.packages('forecast', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""
